personality_one_liner: A friendly, touchable, and engaging educational companion that turns school management from a chore into a rewarding daily habit.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Allow the UI to breathe. Never cramp cards together. Use md or lg padding for cards.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use glass on the Pomodoro timer floating controls.
dont's: Do not use glass on regular list items or task cards.
Do not blur form inputs or text areas.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Google sign-in entry point with an aesthetic educational hero background.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored spinner over the background image.
states.error: Error toast over the login screen.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image (students studying). Absolute positioned vertical linear-gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse at bottom). Bottom 35% contains the app title (Figtree, 2xl, onSurfaceInverse), subtitle, and a full-width pill-shaped Google login button.

screens.name: Initial Assessment
screens.purpose: Onboarding step to identify strengths in 5 key subjects.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking the 5 subject layout.

screens.layout: Scrollable single column. Top features a playful welcoming header. Below are 5 stacked cards for the subjects. Each card has lg padding, shadow_tier 2, and a large tinted icon container (brandTertiary) with a Phosphor icon representing the subject. A primary CTA 'Abrir evaluación' sits inside each card or below the description.

screens.name: Home (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: A quick overview of the student's day, tasks, and academic performance.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for task lists and grade summaries.
states.empty: Illustration of a student resting, 'No pending tasks today!'

screens.layout: Vertical scroll layout. Sticky glass header with greeting and student avatar. Section 1: 'Próximas entregas' (horizontal scroll of task cards). Section 2: 'Mi Rendimiento' (two column grid: one card for Grades Average, one for Pomodoro quick-start). Section 3: 'Accesos rápidos' (Chips or grid of secondary actions like Resources).

screens.name: Tasks
screens.purpose: CRUD interface for homework and school assignments.

states.empty: Illustration + 'Aún no tienes tareas asignadas.' + Add Task CTA.

screens.layout: List view. Each row has a minimum 56pt height, displaying task title, subject tag (tinted chip), and a priority indicator. A floating action button (FAB) with glass effect sits at the bottom right for creating a new task. The 'Add Task' sheet uses a bottom sheet with form inputs (Subject, Date, Priority).

screens.name: Grades
screens.purpose: Track subject performance and visualize academic evolution.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No hay calificaciones registradas en este periodo.'

screens.layout: Top section shows a large general average in a brand-tinted card. Below is a 1-column list of subjects. Tapping a subject expands to show individual activity grades. Use visual progress bars or trend arrows (success/error colors) to show evolution.

screens.name: Pomodoro Timer
screens.purpose: A focused timer for study sessions.
screens.layout: Centered massive circular timer (Tactile style, oversized fonts). Below it, a segmented control or playful pill buttons for 15/25/45/60 min options. Large Primary CTA 'Iniciar'. The background can have subtle Skia noise or a very soft brandTertiary radial gradient.

screens.name: Calendar
screens.purpose: Monthly view of deadlines and study sessions.

states.empty: Calendar grid visible but no events on selected day.

screens.layout: Standard monthly calendar grid at the top. Selecting a day updates the list below it. List shows tasks or study sessions with time blocks and subject colors.

screens.name: Resources Library

states.empty: Illustration + 'No hay recursos disponibles en esta categoría.'

screens.layout: Horizontal sticky filter pills at the top (All, Math, Science, etc.). Below, a 2-column grid of resource cards. Each card has an image thumbnail (with gradient scrim and play icon if video), title, and difficulty badge.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Top cover banner (tinted brand image) with the student's avatar overlapping the bottom edge. Below: Name, Grade (9°), Email. Then a list of settings rows (using brandTertiary tinted icon containers) for Theme, Notifications, and a destructive 'Cerrar sesión' button at the bottom.

login_hero.alt: Aesthetic high school student studying in a modern library

empty_tasks.alt: Focused student with books - representing study time

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful LIGHT personality: use generous rounded corners (lg to pill), oversized tap targets, and avoid sharp brutalist edges.
No Blue or Purple colors: All accents must be Emerald/Mint (brand) or Amber (warning/secondary). Navy and Sky Blue are strictly banned.
Implement a bottom tab bar with 4 tabs: Inicio, Tareas, Calendario, Perfil. (Max 4 as requested, with Calificaciones and Pomodoro accessible via Home/Profile).
Apply the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern on the Login screen background image to ensure text contrast (transparent at top, 80% surfaceInverse at bottom).
Use Phosphor icons with filled variations for active states and outlined for inactive states in the tab bar.
Forms (like Add Task) must use standard single-column layouts with labels above inputs and a sticky CTA button at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView.
Do not use generic emojis for subjects or empty states; rely on Phosphor icons inside brandTertiary tinted containers or actual images.
